Guidance only, not veterinary advice. If you\'re worried about your dog, contact a vet.
The overall rating for an hour is the worst of these factors. Sensitivity changes only the heat and pavement limits.
Heat (air temperature). Normal: Go below 20 °C, Caution from 20 °C to below 25 °C, Avoid from 25 °C. Sensitive: Go below 16 °C, Caution from 16 °C to below 21 °C, Avoid from 21 °C.
Hot pavement: rated only in daylight (between local sunrise and sunset) when the forecast cloud cover is below 50 percent. It uses the same temperature bands as heat.
Rain (precipitation rate): Go below 0.5 mm/h, Caution from 0.5 mm/h to 4 mm/h, Avoid above 4 mm/h.
Wind (mean speed): Go below 25 mph, Caution from 25 mph to below 39 mph, Avoid from 39 mph. Gusts are not rated.
Cold (air temperature): Caution at 0 °C or below. Cold never gives Avoid.
The thresholds are based on this guidance. It is general guidance, and forecasts can be wrong.
Vets Now: heat-related illness can start above about 20 °C.
FOUR PAWS UK: asphalt reaches about 52 °C when the air is 25 °C.
The wind thresholds follow the Beaufort scale\'s mean wind speeds, as published by the Royal Meteorological Society.
